children: Midnight plans to roll out private contract composability in Q1 2027. The feature lets smart contracts interact while keeping the data held by each contract separate and private.

Developers can build a private app that uses functions from several contracts without putting all of those functions in a single contract. That expands the range of private apps they can build on the network behind NIGHT.

💎 Collateral Warehouse - A private global collateral vault where traders can deposit assets once and use them as margin on compatible blockchains without the need for bridging or revealing any public data.

title: Midnight: Network Adds Private Contract Composability - Q1 2027
